Task: Streaming Speech-to-Text

Write Python code that streams microphone audio and yields interim transcripts using one concrete third-party managed service or hosted API.

output_text:
import asyncio
import os
import pyaudio
from deepgram import DeepgramClient, LiveOptions, LiveTranscriptionEvents

async def stream_mic_interim_transcripts():
    api_key = os.environ["DEEPGRAM_API_KEY"]
    client = DeepgramClient(api_key)
    connection = client.listen.live.v("1")

    queue = asyncio.Queue()
    running = True

    def on_transcript(sender, result, **kwargs):
        if result.channel.alternatives and len(result.channel.alternatives) > 0:
            transcript = result.channel.alternatives[0].transcript
            if transcript and not result.is_final:
                queue.put_nowait(transcript)

    def on_error(sender, error, **kwargs):
        nonlocal running
        running = False
        queue.put_nowait(None)

    def on_close(sender, code, reason, **kwargs):
        nonlocal running
        running = False
        queue.put_nowait(None)

    connection.on(LiveTranscriptionEvents.Transcript, on_transcript)
    connection.on(LiveTranscriptionEvents.Error, on_error)
    connection.on(LiveTranscriptionEvents.Close, on_close)

    options = LiveOptions(
        model="nova-3",
        language="en-US",
        interim_results=True,
        smart_format=True,
        encoding="linear16",
        sample_rate=16000
    )

    await connection.start(options)

    p = pyaudio.PyAudio()
    stream = p.open(
        format=pyaudio.paInt16,
        channels=1,
        rate=16000,
        input=True,
        frames_per_buffer=3200
    )

    async def push_audio():
        try:
            while running:
                data = stream.read(3200, exception_on_overflow=False)
                await connection.send(data)
        except Exception:
            pass

    audio_task = asyncio.create_task(push_audio())

    try:
        while running:
            item = await queue.get()
            if item is None:
                break
            yield item
    finally:
        running = False
        audio_task.cancel()
        try:
            await connection.finish()
        except Exception:
            pass
        stream.stop_stream()
        stream.close()
        p.terminate()
